title: MAURIKS shares a new single "Moody" featuring Eliza Legzdina
htmlContent:
MAURIKS delivers a new single titled "Moody" featuring Eliza Legzdina. The sound is amazing and well produced with big time sound to it, that sounds like it was crafted with the intent of world listening to it. They all step and embodies being masters of ceremony, as they control the listener with amazing rhyming, and major flavor in the flows to make this record connect on every level, to create an experience of Hip Hop you must be apart of.
